request.questionText: In a linear regression model, we describe data by an equation: yi=β0+β1∗xi+ei Which of the following is accurate for this equation? Select all correct answers.

choices.label: A
choices.text: The slope of the regression line is β 1 The slope of the regression line is β1\beta_1

choices.label: B
choices.text: The predictor (explanatory) variable is represented by x i The predictor (explanatory) variable is represented by xix_i

choices.label: C
choices.text: Model error is represented by e i Model error is represented by eie_i

choices.label: D
choices.text: The intercept of the regression line is β 0 The intercept of the regression line is β0\beta_0
